page.headline: Year one: 3 partner firms live, 17 portal pages, and 114 times the monthly build rate
page.sub: Since the portal (Nov 12, 2025) and workspace (Nov 18, 2025) repositories began: 60,101 commits across both. Andrew built alone through February; an AI agent organization joined on Mar 2, 2026 and now writes almost every commit.
page.chart_read: Weekly commits rose from a few dozen to 7,198 at the peak. Agents took over in March, and monthly volume has more than doubled every two months on average since.
page.source: Sources: git history of ajb_workspace and portal (all branches); portal deploy tags; deploy ledger org/critical_paths/change_management; research files in this folder

phases.name: Founder build
phases.text: Andrew built alone: the news scanner, Market Overview and seven more analysis pages live by Jan 4, Advisor Intelligence on 49 Financial data, and every Lambda moved under Terraform.

phases.name: Agents join
phases.text: An AI agent organization starts committing on Mar 2. The portal deploys itself on every production push from Mar 23, and the first three partner firms go live between Apr 15 and Apr 29.

phases.name: An operating fabric
phases.text: Model portfolios refresh daily for every partner, the Opal gateway brings Teams, email and data into Claude, every cloud change gets a deploy record, and Schwab becomes 49 Financial's source of record.

phases.name: Scale
phases.text: A ten-step workflow hands build steps to disposable worker agents. The daily operating report goes live, the Investor Reporting backend is deployed, and September closes at 18,656 commits.

notes: A commit is one saved change. Counts cover both repositories, all branches, with merges excluded, and are measured from git.
The kind of work (the three colored bands) is inferred from the files each commit touched, using the same rules as the Daily Operating Report.

Commit volume measures activity, not output. Product-build commits rose about 15 times (136 in December to 2,038 in September); most of the added volume is coordination and controls (49% of the year), the records that let many agents work in parallel safely.
Portal page dates are the day each page was first built (measured). Production dates before Feb 26, 2026 are bounds, because the portal's deploy tags start that day.
Pipeline dates are the day a schedule first appeared in the infrastructure code unless a first run is cited, so they are marked inferred.
The news scanner and the 49 Financial relationship both predate the repositories; their dates here are the earliest git evidence.
Not covered: the opal_ai and mcportal repositories, and the separate tradeops fabric.
